name: dsh-desktop-notify
description: Local persistent Web plugin: desktop notifications through the browser's Notification API. A bell button in the conversation header grants the permission (one user gesture) and toggles the feature; the plugin then watches ctx.uiSession.sessionStatus and fires a system notification when a top-level session's turn finishes (running true → false) or when the agent starts waiting for you (approval / question / plan-review pending). Notifies only while the page is open and not focused. TypeScript: host half index.ts (type stripping), browser half src/client.ts → lib/client.js (tsdown, react left external as a platform seed).
